note: Delaware has no statewide ballot measures on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot. Delaware constitutional amendments are not put to voters: under Article XVI, Section 1 of the Delaware Constitution a proposed amendment passed by one General Assembly must be passed again by the next General Assembly after the general election. The General Assembly's pre-election notice of amendments proposed by the 153rd General Assembly (linked from the Department of Elections home page) states they "must also be passed by the 154th General Assembly after the General Election". Sources: https://elections.delaware.gov/ and https://legis.delaware.gov/docs/default-source/default-document-library/153rdgaconstamendtextfinal.pdf (read 2026-11-03).
